decision.reasoning_trace: I prioritized finding a highly-rated, durable, and portable speaker. I immediately filtered out accessories (cases/straps) and specialty products like the Bluetooth hat and glasses, which had poor or niche reviews. Within my consideration set, I included established brands (JBL, Bose, Altec Lansing) and well-reviewed performance options (BOGASING, DOSS). The JBL Clip 3 was selected as the final choice because it has an overwhelming number of positive reviews (4.7 rating over 68k reviews) and a rugged design with an integrated carabiner, making it the most reliable and practical choice for portable use at a mid-range price point of $54.95.
